lines.trans: The main thing is, never repeat my mistakes.
Find yourself a normal, modest, simple guy.
So that you are in first place for him.
And so that you do not have to remove foolish tattoos.
We once decided to get tattoos with our names.
And why did you come to see me at all?
Mom, I heard you fired people today.
Did you come again to ask on behalf of your Denis?
And for Sveta too, she is my friend.
Alright, let them both keep working in peace.
Excuse me, please, I was just lost in thought a bit.
Listen, let us dance right now right in the coffee shop?
Let us do it, after all this is my favorite song!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'you (informal)', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Виктор, ты этот тонкий намёк понял?

examples.trans: Sveta, let us just forget about the accident.

examples.text: Света, не расстраивайся, Катя поговорит с мамой.
examples.trans: Sveta, do not be upset, Katya will talk to her mom.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'also', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Нам тоже нужна статья!
examples.trans: We need an article too!

examples.text: Кстати, я тоже там у тебя в друзьях.
examples.trans: By the way, I am also on your friends list there.

examples.text: И за Свету тоже, она моя подруга.
examples.trans: And for Sveta too, she is my friend.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'she', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Она машину совсем не заметила.
examples.trans: She did not notice the car at all.

examples.text: Она просит прийти лично с деньгами.
examples.trans: She asks me to come in person with the money.

examples.text: Это она внезапно на главную вылетела.
examples.trans: She was the one who suddenly flew onto the main road.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'руга'). Common feminine noun meaning 'female friend' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Мама с подругой хотят у нас пообедать.
examples.trans: Mom and her friend want to have lunch at our place.

examples.text: Мама, привет, ну и где подруга?
examples.trans: Mom, hello, so where is your friend?

examples.text: Познакомься, сынок, это моя подруга Лариса.
examples.trans: Meet her, son, this is my friend Larisa.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Ладно, я всё прекрасно понял.
examples.trans: Alright, I understood everything perfectly.

examples.text: Ладно, просто оставь это на столе.
examples.trans: Alright, just leave it on the table.

examples.text: Ладно, ты спокойно лечи свою руку.
examples.trans: Alright, you calmly treat your arm.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'let (them)', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Пусть они оплачивают врача и рентген.
examples.trans: Let them pay for the doctor and the X-ray.

examples.text: Ладно, пусть они оба дальше спокойно работают.
examples.trans: Alright, let them both keep working in peace.

examples.text: Ладно, пусть дальше спокойно работают.
examples.trans: Alright, let them keep working in peace.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'they', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Пусть они оплачивают врача и рентген.
examples.trans: Let them pay for the doctor and the X-ray.

examples.text: Ты не понимаешь, мама вас специально сводит.
examples.trans: You do not understand, mom is purposefully setting you up.

examples.text: Лёва не понимает, что мама его сводит.
examples.trans: Lyova does not understand that his mom is setting him up.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian cardinal or ordinal numeral meaning 'both', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Почему мы сегодня оба такие стеснительные?
examples.trans: Why are we both so shy today?

examples.text: Вы оба сегодня уволены!
examples.trans: You are both fired today!

examples.text: Давайте добавим сюда ещё одно красивое слово.
examples.trans: Let us add one more beautiful word here.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'further, on', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Ладно, пусть они оба дальше спокойно работают.
examples.trans: Alright, let them both keep working in peace.

examples.text: Ладно, пусть дальше спокойно работают.
examples.trans: Alright, let them keep working in peace.

examples.text: Хорошо. Дальше.
examples.trans: All right. Next.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'покойно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Денис, дыши спокойно, сейчас вызовем скорую.
examples.trans: Denis, breathe calmly, we will call an ambulance now.

examples.text: Женись спокойно, а я поставил деньги.
examples.trans: Get married in peace, and I placed a bet.

examples.text: Ладно, ты спокойно лечи свою руку.
examples.trans: Alright, you calmly treat your arm.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to work', paired with 'поработать'.

examples.text: Я пока спокойно поработаю за ноутбуком.
examples.trans: Meanwhile I will work quietly on the laptop.

examples.text: Простите, но мне пора идти работать.
examples.trans: Forgive me, but it is time for me to go work.

examples.text: Не можешь нормально работать, тогда уходи.
examples.trans: If you cannot work properly, then leave.

meanings.note: Prefix 'из-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'винить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'sorry', paired with 'извинять'.

examples.text: Я прошу, позволь мне сейчас извиниться.
examples.trans: I beg you, allow me to apologize right now.

examples.text: Извините, я сейчас быстро начну играть.
examples.trans: Excuse me, I will quickly start playing right now.

examples.text: Извини, пожалуйста, я просто немного задумался.
examples.trans: Excuse me, please, I was just lost in thought a bit.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'жалуйста').

examples.text: Вот, пожалуйста, приятного аппетита.
examples.trans: Here you go, enjoy your meal.

examples.text: Денис, пожалуйста, только снова не начинай.
examples.trans: Denis, please, just do not start again.

examples.text: Пожалуйста, принесите гостье чистую вилку.
examples.trans: Please bring the guest a clean fork.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Всё нормально, я просто конфетой подавился.
examples.trans: Everything is fine, I just choked on a candy.

examples.text: Ой, это просто настоящий детский сад.
examples.trans: Oh, this is just a real kindergarten.

examples.text: Она просит прийти лично с деньгами.
examples.trans: She asks me to come in person with the money.

meanings.note: Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'много'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Девочки, давайте сейчас немного успокоимся.
examples.trans: Girls, let us calm down a bit right now.

examples.text: Мне кажется, вы сейчас немного преувеличиваете.
examples.trans: It seems to me you are exaggerating a little right now.

examples.text: Вкусного кофе выпьем и немного расслабимся.
examples.trans: We will drink some tasty coffee and relax a little.

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'думаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'got lost in thought'.

related.gloss: to got lost in thought (prefixed perfective)
not to got lost in thought (negated infinitive)

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и задуматься вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and got lost in thought on time.

examples.text: На нашей кухне все умеют задуматься.
examples.trans: In our kitchen everyone knows how to got lost in thought.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'лушать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'listen', paired with 'послушать'.

examples.text: Вы только послушайте эти красивые слова.
examples.trans: Just listen to these beautiful words.

examples.text: Да, и она меня спокойно выслушала.
examples.trans: Yes, and she listened to me calmly.

examples.text: Слушай, но мы ведь уехали оттуда.
examples.trans: Listen, but we drove away from there.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'come on', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

related.gloss: to give (the verb it comes from)

examples.text: Всё нормально, я просто конфетой подавился.
examples.trans: Everything is fine, I just choked on a candy.

examples.text: Девочки, давайте сейчас немного успокоимся.
examples.trans: Girls, let us calm down a bit right now.

examples.text: Света, давай просто забудем про аварию.
examples.trans: Sveta, let us just forget about the accident.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ейчас').

examples.text: Денис, дыши спокойно, сейчас вызовем скорую.
examples.trans: Denis, breathe calmly, we will call an ambulance now.

examples.text: Девочки, давайте сейчас немного успокоимся.
examples.trans: Girls, let us calm down a bit right now.

examples.text: Мне кажется, вы сейчас немного преувеличиваете.
examples.trans: It seems to me you are exaggerating a little right now.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'танцевать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'let us dance'.

related.gloss: not to let us dance (negated infinitive)

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и потанцевать вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and let us dance on time.

examples.text: На нашей кухне все умеют потанцевать.
examples.trans: In our kitchen everyone knows how to let us dance.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Прямо сейчас, ведь сегодня день ужасный.
examples.trans: Right now, after all today is a terrible day.

examples.text: Слушай, давай сейчас потанцуем прямо в кофейне?
examples.trans: Listen, let us dance right now right in the coffee shop?

examples.text: Выбирай прямо сейчас: или она, или я!
examples.trans: Choose right now: either her or me!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'in, into', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Она машину совсем не заметила.
examples.trans: She did not notice the car at all.

examples.text: Денис, дыши спокойно, сейчас вызовем скорую.
examples.trans: Denis, breathe calmly, we will call an ambulance now.

examples.text: Всё нормально, я просто конфетой подавился.
examples.trans: Everything is fine, I just choked on a candy.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'in a coffee shop' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Слушай, давай сейчас потанцуем прямо в кофейне?
examples.trans: Listen, let us dance right now right in the coffee shop?

examples.text: На кухне отеля всегда есть кофейня.
examples.trans: In the hotel kitchen there is always in a coffee shop.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'after all', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Элеонора Андреевна, ведь это совсем несправедливо.
examples.trans: Eleonora Andreevna, after all this is completely unfair.

examples.text: А жизнь вообще очень несправедливая штука!
examples.trans: And life in general is a very unfair thing!

examples.text: Но ведь это же твои честные слова!
examples.trans: But after all, those are your honest words!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'this, it (is)', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Виктор, ты этот тонкий намёк понял?
examples.trans: Viktor, did you understand that subtle hint?

examples.text: Ой, это просто настоящий детский сад.
examples.trans: Oh, this is just a real kindergarten.

examples.text: Атмосфера этого ресторана подкупает каждого гостя.
examples.trans: The atmosphere of this restaurant wins over every guest.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'амый'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('most').

examples.text: Лариса самая заботливая медсестра в поликлинике.
examples.trans: Larisa is the most caring nurse at the clinic.

examples.text: Удивит всех гостей самыми изысканными блюдами.
examples.trans: Will amaze all guests with the most exquisite dishes.

examples.text: Давай, ведь это моя самая любимая песня!
examples.trans: Let us do it, after all this is my favorite song!

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('favourite, beloved').

examples.text: Эта статья — моя любимая серьёзная работа.
examples.trans: This article is my beloved serious work.

examples.text: Хорошо, любимая, вечером обязательно приду домой.
examples.trans: Alright, darling, I will definitely come home tonight.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'song' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Давай, ведь это моя самая любимая песня!
examples.trans: Let us do it, after all this is my favorite song!

examples.text: Песни орём!
examples.trans: Bellowing songs!

examples.text: Это моя любимая старая песня.
examples.trans: This is my favourite old song.
